newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$9.00/cubic metre or C$1.43/barrel, effective immediately.
The new prices were listed as follows:
Edmonton light sweet C$201.00/cubic metre, or C$31.96/barrel
Cromer light sour C$194.00/cubic metre, or C$30.43/barrel
Bow River at Hardisty C$165.00/cubic metre, or C$26.23/barrel
Midale at Cromer C$171.00/cubic metre, or C$27.19/barrel
